tools.name: Domain-local Hurwitz zero transport for real-rooted approximants
tools.abstraction: If holomorphic approximants are zero-free off the real axis in an open target domain and converge locally uniformly there to a nonzero holomorphic limit, then Hurwitz prevents new nonreal limit zeros in that domain; Rouche/Hurwitz counting transports local multiplicity on zero-isolating compact contours.
preconditions: there is a fixed open complex domain D in which each approximant is holomorphic
each approximant has no zeros in D minus the real axis
the approximants converge locally uniformly on D to a holomorphic limit not identically zero
for multiplicity transfer, the chosen contour lies compactly inside D and its boundary is zero-free for the limit
reuse relies on the standard Hurwitz/Rouche theorem, not on PR15 preregistration or result chronology
structural_signature: real-zero or off-real zero-free finite-stage property
locally uniform convergence on a fixed open domain
tools.operation: for any proposed spectral/determinant route, identify the minimal root-relevant open domain, prove source-normalized local-uniform convergence on every compact subset of that domain, then apply Hurwitz off the real axis and Rouche/Hurwitz counting near isolated target zeros
guaranteed_effects: rules out nonreal zeros of the nonzero limit inside the proved convergence domain
transports the total zero multiplicity inside any sufficiently small zero-isolating contour compactly contained in the domain
non_guarantees: does not prove source-side convergence or normalization
does not identify the limit with Xi
does not control zeros outside the convergence domain
does not by itself prove that the chosen domain contains every root-relevant nontrivial Xi zero
does not convert the retrospective PR15 case record into preregistered validator evidence
does not merge with or inherit authority from the distinct 11-case preregistered local lineage
validation_obligations: freeze the target domain before evaluation and justify why it covers the root-relevant zeros
verify local-uniform rather than pointwise/zero-prefix/statistical convergence
verify the limit is not identically zero and is exactly the intended arithmetic target
verify finite-stage zero-free/real-rooted hypotheses on the same cofinal family
keep any source-side normalization fixed independently of known target zeros
cite and independently check the applicable Hurwitz/Rouche hypotheses; PR15 is only retrospective provenance
evidence_pointers: Alain Connes, Caterina Consani, Henri Moscovici, Zeta Spectral Triples, arXiv:2511.22755 (2025), Sections 7-8
